svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Two Metal hosts. Atlas calls metald on each host over mutual TLS. metald starts Firecracker VMs and keeps their disks in a ZFS pool. VMs connect through a veth link to wg0 with eBPF programs. The two hosts share a WireGuard tunnel, and the two metald daemons talk directly for migration. Object storage sends images to the ZFS pools and receives snapshots.
